headline: Georgian Court turn the tables at Millersville
dek: Georgian Court won at Millersville, where they had lost without reply in September. The win was their thirteenth, more than any other programme in the conference has managed this season.
displaced_by: Georgian Court have now played and won at Millersville, so the standing dek's 'go to Millersville with twelve wins' is no longer true
